The concept of resilience, introduced in [53] and later generalized in [13], provides a sufficient condition for learning under adversarial corruption. While resilience enables simple exponential‑time robust estimators, the high sensitivity of such methods poses challenges for achieving differential privacy, motivating further investigation into private algorithms that can exploit resilience under sub‑Gaussian and heavy‑tailed settings."
